skill.name: smart-bug-fix
skill.description: Guides a systematic bug-fix workflow that combines root cause analysis, alternative fixes, Codex implementation, testing, regression checks, and performance review.
skill.summary: Find root causes, apply guided fixes, and validate results with tests and regression checks.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline command names, examples, and diagrams. I confirmed the executable bash workflow and xargs file traversal patterns because they direct agents to run external CLIs over user-provided paths. I also found semantic risks around sending code context to Gemini and using full-auto code modification without an explicit human approval gate.

remediation.issue: Executable shell workflow in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Convert the bash block to pseudocode, or require explicit confirmation before each external CLI command runs.

remediation.issue: Potential code disclosure through Gemini context analysis
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit privacy warning, repository allowlist, redaction guidance, and an opt-in step before sending files to remote models.
Use grouped find expressions with null-delimited output, limit context_path to the project root, and handle empty results.

remediation.issue: Full-auto code changes without approval gate
remediation.suggestion: Require a diff preview, branch check, rollback instructions, and human approval before applying or merging generated fixes.

semantic_findings.title: Potential Code Disclosure to External Model Service
semantic_findings.description: The workflow calls Gemini with the supplied context path for large repositories. This can transmit proprietary code to an external model service without explicit consent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 83-89 conditionally run the Gemini CLI with files set to the user-provided context path. This directly supports code disclosure risk, although the actual transport depends on the user Gemini setup.

semantic_findings.title: Autonomous Code Modification Without Approval Gate
semantic_findings.description: The workflow instructs Codex full-auto to fix a user-described bug using the supplied context path, with no documented diff approval before generated changes are produced.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 100-111 pass the bug description and context path into Codex and enable a full-auto fix workflow. Sandbox and network-disabled flags reduce impact, but the skill does not require human approval before modification.

content.user_title: Fix Bugs with Root Cause Analysis
content.value_statement: Bug fixes can fail when teams skip root cause analysis. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through diagnosis, implementation, tests, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Collects a bug description, context path, reproduction steps, error logs, and desired analysis depth.
Runs a root cause analysis phase before recommending or applying a fix.
Uses Codex to generate alternative approaches and apply a sandboxed fix workflow.
Runs functionality and regression validation with a bounded iteration count.
Summarizes root cause, test status, changed files, and performance impact.
limitations: Requires compatible Claude Flow, Gemini, Codex, jq, and shell tooling to be available.
May send selected code context to external model services when the workflow uses Gemini.
Automated fixes still require human review before merging or deploying.
The documented shell workflow is illustrative and may need project-specific adaptation.

use_cases.title: Fix Feature Regressions
use_cases.description: Application developers can trace a regression to its cause, apply a focused fix, and verify tests before review.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Bugs
use_cases.description: Incident responders can combine logs, reproduction steps, and impact checks to prepare a safer remediation plan.

use_cases.title: Review Complex Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Tech leads can compare alternative fixes and request validation evidence before approving a change.

prompt_templates.title: Report a Simple Bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: provide the minimum required details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix this bug with smart-bug-fix: [describe the failure]. Context path: [file or folder]. Explain the root cause and validation.

prompt_templates.title: Add Reproduction Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: include user steps and observed behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use smart-bug-fix on [context path]. Bug: [description]. Reproduction steps: [steps]. Include the likely cause, proposed fix, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Logs and Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: combine logs, failing tests, and suspected files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deep smart-bug-fix analysis for [bug]. Use [context path], [error logs], and [failing tests]. Compare alternatives before applying changes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Production Regression
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: require rollback awareness and impact review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use smart-bug-fix for a production regression in [system]. Include RCA, Codex fix rationale, regression validation, performance impact, and residual risks.

output_examples.input: Bug: login fails on Firefox. Context: authentication module. Reproduction steps are available.
output: Identifies browser-specific token handling as the likely cause.
Applies a focused authentication fix in a sandboxed workflow.
Reports passing tests, regression status, and performance impact.

output_examples.input: Bug: API timeouts under load. Context: API service with recent latency logs.
output: Analyzes logs and code paths before changing behavior.
Compares more than one fix approach.
Summarizes changed files, validation status, and remaining risk.

output_examples.input: Bug: database connection errors after deploy. Context: database adapter and deploy logs.
output_examples.output: The workflow produces a root cause narrative, fix rationale, validation summary, and escalation note when tests fail.

best_practices: Review the root cause evidence before accepting an automated fix.
Run the workflow in a clean branch with project tests available.
Confirm any external model use is allowed for the repository.
anti_patterns: Do not run full-auto fixes on production files without a review step.
Do not pass secrets, private logs, or broad filesystem paths as context.
Do not treat a passing test summary as deployment approval.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically modify code?
faq.answer: It describes a Codex auto-fix phase, so users should run it only in a controlled branch or sandbox.

faq.question: Can it use multiple AI models?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow references Claude for analysis, Codex for implementation, and Gemini for large context analysis.

faq.question: Does it replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It provides diagnosis, fix rationale, and validation evidence for reviewers.

faq.question: What inputs are most useful?
faq.answer: A clear bug description, a narrow context path, reproduction steps, logs, and failing tests are most useful.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private code?
faq.answer: Use caution. The workflow may send selected code context to external model services during large codebase analysis.

faq.question: What happens when tests fail?
faq.answer: The skill escalates after the configured iteration limit and asks for another approach or more context.
